notes.title: GladValakas - Cyberban: final update.
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

For all fans of Glad Valakas, our team has released the final mini-update!
In this update you will find:
[list]
[*] 6 new achievements (one of them is hidden, try to get it).
[*] 15 new photos!
[*] In the game during the New Year holidays it will snow, a pleasant trifle that will create a New Year mood.
[/list]

And finally, a nice bonus for everyone: a discount on GladValakas - Cyberban during the winter holidays!
Happy New Year to all! ːsteamhappyː

[b]Nozhin games studio[/b]

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] For each world, updated sprites. Now every world has an updated visual look.
[*] Updated sprites for the boss arena.
[*] Slightly improved the background for the main menu.
[*] Now the animation of the transition to the level will be played.
[*] Improved the background. Backgrounds will now play animation.
[*] At the levels will now be vending machines with cartridges and health.
[*] At the levels added new zones. These zones are without enemies, there you have to jump like a rabbit. 
[*] Updated old and added new events, complicated and diversified them.
[*] Added mini-games. Play them to hack terminals.
[*] And also in the game now 57 new achievements!
[/list]


[b]All this in Update 2.0[/b]
